files.content:
name: GeminiSupervisor Dependency Sync

on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
    paths:
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/README.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/MANIFEST.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Sync stable readers and touch sentinel
        run: |
          node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/sync-stable-readers.js

      - name: Commit stable readers and sentinel if modified
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/stable-readers/ ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/.gemini-supervisor-sync-sentinel
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "Stable readers and sentinel are clean. No commit required."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): sync stable readers from canonical sources [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

files.purpose: Dual-phase challenge lifecycle workflow handling selector-triggered generation and active-projection-triggered verification with recursive trigger prevention.
files.content:
name: Truth Challenge Lifecycle

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-selector.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  lifecycle:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Determine Trigger and Execute Engine
        id: engine
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          # Check if commit touched active-projections (verification phase)
          MODIFIED_PROJECTIONS=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r ${{ github.sha }} | grep -E '^ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/' || true)
          MODIFIED_SELECTOR=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r ${{ github.sha }} | grep -E '^ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-selector.json' || true)

          if [ -n "$MODIFIED_PROJECTIONS" ]; then
            echo "Executing VERIFY phase..."
            node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/truth-challenge-engine.js verify
            git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-selector.json \
                    ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-status.json \
                    ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/ \
                    ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/.truth-snapshots/ || true
            if git diff --staged --quiet; then
              echo "No verification state changes to commit."
            else
              git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): challenge verification update [skip ci]"
              git push
            fi
          elif [ -n "$MODIFIED_SELECTOR" ]; then
            echo "Executing GENERATE phase..."
            node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/truth-challenge-engine.js generate
            git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-status.json \
                    ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/ \
                    ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/.truth-snapshots/
            if git diff --staged --quiet; then
              echo "No challenge generation changes to commit."
            else
              git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): publish seeded active projections [skip ci]"
              git push
            fi
          else
            echo "Workflow triggered without specific target changes."
          fi
